sentences.text: No, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges for all floating rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals, with or without co-obligant(s), so the documents do not state that a 5% foreclosure (pre-closure) charge may be charged on a floating-rate home loan to an individual.
The bank’s own Home Loan Agreement says the Borrower shall pay a pre-payment charge of 2% of the principal outstanding on foreclosure or pre-payment, which does not state a 5% charge.
